stemBlocks: Four resistors, P, Q, R and S, are connected to a battery with negligible internal resistance, as shown in the diagram.

P and S each have resistance $x$. Q and R each have resistance $2x$.
A fifth resistor, T, which has resistance $x$, is to be added to the circuit in one of the following listed positions, as shown in the diagram:
1 in parallel with P
2 in series with Q
3 in parallel with R
Which of the positions for resistor T causes an increase in the magnitude of the voltmeter reading?
